# Newegg

> > Newegg is a leading online electronics retailer specializing in PC components, gaming hardware, laptops, and consumer electronics with daily flash sales and promotional deals.

Newegg.com is a comprehensive electronics marketplace offering everything from high-performance PC components (CPUs, GPUs, SSDs) to complete computer systems, gaming peripherals, home appliances, and networking equipment. The site features prominent promotional channels like Shell Shocker flash sales and clearance events alongside curated product catalogs organized by category.

## Key Topics

- PC Components
- Graphics Cards (GPUs)
- AMD Ryzen Processors
- Gaming Desktops
- Laptops
- SSDs & Storage
- Gaming Monitors
- Shell Shocker Flash Sales
- Clearance Deals
- Computer Systems
- DDR5 Memory
- Gaming Peripherals
- Server Hardware
- AI PCs
- Networking Products

## Featured Deals & Promotions

- [Shell Shocker Deals: Best Electronics Sales Today | Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/Shell-Shocker/EventSaleStore/ID-10381): Shell Shocker flash sales featuring limited-time electronics & GPU deals

- [Premium Laptops Upgrade Deals | Copilot+ & Ryzen AI Savings | Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/Premium-Laptops-Upgrade/EventSaleStore/ID-10391): Premium laptop deals featuring Copilot+ PCs with Ryzen AI & Intel Ultra
- [Free Gift w/ AMD | Newegg.com](https://www.newegg.com/AMD-CPU-Free-Storage/EventSaleStore/ID-10389): AMD Ryzen CPU promotional bundle with free gift offers on processors
- [Best Selling Products | Newegg.com](https://www.newegg.com/d/best-sellers): Top 100 best-selling products including gaming PCs, laptops & GPUs
